payload.title: Erdtree Seal
payload.text:
Does NOT increase the damage of Erdtree Incantations, despite the name and association with that incantation type.
The strongest Faith-only Sacred Seal when the stat is above 68.
Gets 353 Incantation Scaling at 80 Faith when the seal is at +10. The other seals are in the 310 to 330 range at that point.
If using only a single Seal, other Faith-only Seals will still outmatch the Erdtree Seal when using the type of incantations that they boost. However, since this boost also applies to other Seals when a spell-boosting seal is held in an active hand, wielding two Seals at the same time makes the Erdtree Seal once again the stronger alternative unless two copies of the same spell-boosting seal are obtained.
Though it won't quite catch up with the Godslayer's Seal (the strongest Seal beforehand) until the Faith stat reaches the 60s, the ease of upgrading it because it requires Somber Smithing Stones (versus the unfortunately generally much rarer Smithing Stones that the Godslayer's Seal needs) means it can still see good use beforehand.
Besides increasing the Seal's Incantation Scaling, the Faith-scaling also increases the its own meager base Physical and Holy damage.
At maximum upgrade level it has 212 Incantation Scaling at 40 Faith (minimum requirement) and 353 Incantation Scaling at 80 Faith.
Has 243 Incantation Scaling at 50 Faith, 273 Scaling at 60 Faith, and 313 Scaling at 70 Faith.

Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] gives access to: Smithing Stone 7, Smithing Stone 8. Found in Crumbling Farum Azula, dropped by the Godskin Duo boss.

payload.title: Skill: Troll's Roar
payload.text:
As the roar is a bullet-type attack on a Heavy Affinity skill its Attack Power scales with the weapon's upgrade level and the user's Strength.
Strength-scaling is greatly increased if the weapon has a Heavy Affinity, slightly increased if it has a Fire Affinity, and somewhat increased on a Quality, Cold, Poison, or Blood Affinity, and greatly decreased if the weapon has a Keen, Lightning, Magic, or Occult Affinity.
Since the Troll's Hammer counts as a Standard Affinity weapon despite its ample Strength-scaling and being unable to change the skill, its roar deals substantially less damage than a Heavy affinity weapon at equivalent levels of Strength (15% less Attack Power at 80 Strength) while the Troll Knight's Sword has somewhat improved Strength-scaling over even Heavy Affinity due to being a Somber weapon with decent Strength-scaling at +0.
Attack Power of the roar is always at least 780 (620 for more distant targets) for a weapon at maximum upgrade level.
A Quality, Cold, Poison, or Blood affinity and 45 Strength gives the roar 1,012 Attack Power (805 against distant targets), while a Fire affinity and either 45 or 80 Strength gives respectively 1,036 Attack Power (824 against distant targets) or 1,149 Attack Power (913 against distant targets), and a Heavy affinity and either 45 or 80 Strength gives respectively 1,122 Attack Power (892 against distant targets) or 1,272 Attack Power (1,011 against distant targets).

Moonlight Altar
Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void at the end of the Lake of Rot and travel up the lift. This lift only unlocks if you have obtained the Dark Moon Ring.

Leyndell, Ashen Capital
After defeating the final boss, there will be a blue summon sign on the Stone Platform. Interact with it to summon Ranni, allowing you to achieve the Age of the Stars ending.

The player receives the Carian Inverted Statue from Ranni the Witch after bringing her the Fingerslayer Blade. The Divine Tower beyond the study hall hides Ranni's true body, which bears the Cursemark of Death.

payload.title: Ainsel River
payload.text:
Map of Ainsel River
One of the two great rivers that flow beneath the Lands Between. Ainsel is said to be the grave of civilisations that flourished before the Erdtree. The eastern side of Ainsel is dominated by the Uhl Palace Ruins, characterised by their mausoleums and statues, and inhabited by the Claymen who served as priests of the ancient dynasty.
Nokstella, one of the Eternal Cities, can be found in the western portion of the subterranean space, inhabited by the Nox who were banished underground by the Greater Will long ago. Deeper still is the Lake of Rot, a putrid underground swamp littered with ancient ruins, where the essence of an Outer God was sealed. At the deepest point is the lair of Astel, a malformed star who once assailed an Eternal City and took away its sky. Beyond Astel is a lift which leads to the Moonlight Altar, provided the Dark Moon Ring has been found.
Ainsel can be accessed via the Ainsel River Well in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes. The Ainsel River Main, which encompasses Nokstella, can be accessed via a sending gate in Renna's Rise, after Ranni the Witch gets her hands on the Fingerslayer Blade.

payload.title: Shadowbound Beast
payload.text:
According to the old legends, wolves are shadows of the Empyrean.
The first named Shadowbound Beast is Maliketh, the Black Blade, who became the loyal shadow and half-brother of Queen Marika the Eternal. However, her sole need of her shadow was a vessel to lock away Destined Death, which was harboured in his sword after the defeat of the Gloam-Eyed Queen. After a fragment of the Rune of Death was stolen during the Night of Black Knives he sealed the rune within his own body so that none could steal Death again. When the stolen fragment sprouted in the form of Deathroot throughout the Lands Between, he would attempt to recover it under the alias Gurranq, Beast Clergyman by consuming the Deathroot.
The other named Shadowbound Beast is Blaidd the Half-Wolf. Blaidd was approved by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon and given to her daughter, the Empyrean Ranni the Witch, at a young age. He became her stepbrother and they grew up together. In defiance of the fate he was born into, he swore to serve no other master but Ranni, assisting her in her rebellion against the Two Fingers. Against his own will, Blaidd would eventually succumb to becoming a Baleful Shadow, but in his final moments gave himself to Ranni.
Although all Shadows who turn on their Empyreans are considered Baleful Shadows, there are particular Baleful Shadows that are assassins of the Two Fingers. The last of the Baleful Shadows is killed by the Tarnished in the Ainsel River during Ranni the Witch's quest.
The Tarnished known as Vargram the Raging Wolf aspired to become a shadow of an Empyrean.

- However, don't be afraid of losing the option to give her the Amber Draught; As you aren't rewarded with anything for trying to give it to her, because it doesn't work on her and only serves to make her disappointed with you and halt her quest line until you seek Absolution at the Church of Vows.
 Upon returning to Ranni and giving her the Fingerslayer Blade, she will reward the player with the Carian Inverted Statue, which they can use at the pedestal at the entrance to the Carian Study Hall to reach the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia. After speaking with her, Ranni will leave to continue her quest alone. Upon arriving at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia, you will be able to find the Cursemark of Death upon the remains of Ranni's original body, which is severely burnt. [...] After giving the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni, you can speak with Iji, and he will tell you where Ranni has gone (mentioning Renna's Rise in the process) and the Carian Filigreed Crest will be added to his merchant inventory for purchase, if you had yet to unlock its availability. [...] NOTE: Giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade will cause Preceptor Seluvis to become a lifeless puppet, which effectively locks you out of further interaction in his questline (And possibly prevents you from giving Seluvis' Potion to Dung Eater). If you want to get the Magic Scorpion Charm from Seluvis in this playthrough, you need to start and/or continue through his quest line until he gifts the amulet to you, before giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. After receiving the Magic Scorpion Charm, you may safely carry on with Ranni's quest line.
  + If Seluvis has given you the Amber Draught to give to Ranni at this point, once you have given her the Fingerslayer Blade you will no longer have the option to give the Amber Draught to Ranni.
